            if ssum > best_sum + 1e-12:
                best_sum = ssum
                best_centers = centers.copy()
                best_radii = radii.copy()

    # final fallback: simple centered hex without rotation
    if best_centers is None:
        s = find_max_s_for_angle(0.0, (0.0,0.0))
        centers = make_hex_centers(s)[:n_target]
        centers = centers[np.lexsort((centers[:,1], centers[:,0]))]
        best_radii = _relax_radii(centers)
        best_centers = centers
        best_sum = float(np.sum(best_radii))

    return best_centers, best_radii, float(best_sum)


def _relax_radii(centers, tol=1e-9, max_iter=2000):
    """Fixed-point relaxation to maximize radii under r_i + r_j <= d_ij and r_i <= border."""
    n = centers.shape[0]
    if n == 0:
        return np.array([])
    border = np.minimum.reduce([centers[:,0], centers[:,1], 1.0 - centers[:,0], 1.0 - centers[:,1]])
    border = np.maximum(border, 0.0)
    dif = centers[:, None, :] - centers[None, :, :]
    D = np.sqrt(np.maximum(0.0, np.sum(dif * dif, axis=2)))
    np.fill_diagonal(D, np.inf)
    # initialize as border
    r = border.copy()
    for _ in range(max_iter):
        allowed = D - r[None, :]   # allowed radii for i given current r_j
        new_r = np.minimum(border, np.maximum(0.0, np.min(allowed, axis=1)))
        change = np.max(np.abs(new_r - r))
        r = new_r
        if change < tol:
            break
    # one pass greedy correction if tiny violations remain
    I, J = np.triu_indices(n, k=1)
    dij = D[I, J]
    rij = r[I] + r[J]
    mask = rij > dij + 1e-12
    if np.any(mask):
        for i, j, d in zip(I[mask], J[mask], dij[mask]):
            if r[i] + r[j] <= d + 1e-12:
                continue
            if r[i] >= r[j]:
                r[i] = max(0.0, d - r[j])
            else:
                r[j] = max(0.0, d - r[i])
        r = np.minimum(r, border)
    return r

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

def run_packing():
    centers, radii, sum_radii = construct_packing()
    return centers, radii, sum_radii

        ax.add_patch(Circle(c, r, alpha=0.6, edgecolor='k'))
    plt.title(f"n={len(centers)}, sum={sum(radii):.6f}")
    plt.show()
